title: Bug 2008907 - Port bug 2008041 - Update the checked state of commands instead of menuitems. r=aleca If a menuitem has an associated command, the checked state of the command seems to take precedence over the checked state of the menuitem. Arguably this is how XUL commands and menuitems always worked, but behaviour has been inconsistent over the years.
